home.welcome_body: Ni urubuga rwa rusange rwa Sisitemu yo Gucunga Itorero rya Arikidiyosezi ya Kigali. Reba amakuru rusange kuri arikidiyosezi; abakozi n'abayobozi barashobora kwinjira kugira bacunge amakuru.
home.discover_subtitle: Amakuru asomwa gusa aboneka kuri bose.
home.cta_body: Injira kugira ngo ukoreshe ibikoresho byo gucunga amaparuwasi, amakuru, imari n'ibindi.

sections.diocese_description: Suzuma amaparuwasi n'imiterere ya Arikidiyosezi ya Kigali binyuze mu rutonde rwa rusange.
sections.faithful_description: Amakuru rusange ku muryango n'ubuvugizi butangwa muri arikidiyosezi.
sections.sacraments_description: Amakuru rusange ku Batisimu, Gukomezwa n'Ugushyingirwa.
sections.archives_description: Inyandiko z'amateka n'izindi zabitswe n'Ububiko bwa Diosezi.
sections.geography_description: Suzuma imiterere y'akarere n'uturere twa arikidiyosezi.
